technique_name: Write an article summarizing the history of fashion in the 1980s.
description: The 1980s was a time of bold fashion statements and colorful styles. The decade began with punk styles, popularized by stars like Madonna and Cyndi Lauper. Bright colors, sequins and neon materials were also popular trends. As the decade went on, so did the trends. Shoulder pads, acid wash denim and "Miami Vice" inspired looks became popular.
